name: Paul Mueller

summary.text: Paul Mueller is an economist, author, and small-business owner in Leadville, Colorado. He is a Senior Research Fellow at the American Institute for Economic Research.

experience.text: Ph.D. in economics, George Mason University; previously taught at The King's College in New York City.
Senior Research Fellow and director of the Defending Freedom and Combating Collectivism initiative at the American Institute for Economic Research.
Owner and operator of The Abbey, a bed and breakfast in Leadville, Colorado.

education_focus.text: Mueller says he would bring 'real budget scrutiny' to the CU System's finances and make sure public funds 'are spent wisely and transparently.'
He says he would protect 'the academic freedom faculty need to teach and research,' paired with what he describes as a campus climate of 'mutual respect and decorum.'
He says he would steward tuition and resources so that 'a CU degree remains a sound investment for Colorado students and families.'
